name: Raiha Räikkönen
source:
Favorite cake: None

Kamiogi Academy second-year and globally renowned pâtissière at Souvenir, a popular rival cake chain. Her public persona is that of a mysterious, unapproachable “ice queen”; in reality, she talks like a tired office worker with a bewilderingly hit-or-miss sense of humor. Half-Finnish and half-Japanese, she relocated to Japan only a few years ago, but seems to have already lost her passion for baking cakes...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369790/Marshmallow_All_the_Way_Home/]Steam[/url]]
